scene: You mount the mechanical brass horse as the carousel begins to whir.
picture: A flat side view of the whirling carousel deck. Left sits an empty painted swan seat. In the centre, the tall Latino man in his teal jacket sits mounted on an ornate brass horse with a wind-up key in its neck. Overhead up high dangles a gold ring, and on the right is the wooden exit platform.
shown: A large wind-up brass key sticking out of the horse's neck in the centre.
An overhead iron arm holding a single dangling gold ring up high.
The stationary wooden exit ramp waiting just beyond the carousel edge on the right.
